items.question: How does peer-to-peer car rental work?
items.answer: CarShare Burundi connects car owners with people wanting to rent a vehicle. Owners publish their listings with photos, price and availability. Renters can browse offers, book directly online, and pick up the car at the agreed location.

items.question: How do I sign up on the platform?
items.answer: Signing up is simple and free. Just click 'Sign up', provide your personal information, a valid ID, and your driving license. Once your account is verified, you can start renting or listing your car.

items.question: What documents do I need to rent a car?
items.answer: To rent a car, you need to present: a valid driving license (national or international), a valid ID, and a bank card for the deposit. Some owners may request additional documents.

items.question: How are prices set?
items.answer: Prices are freely set by owners based on the vehicle model, year, features and demand. Our platform displays transparent prices including service fees. You can easily compare offers.

items.question: What should I do in case of an accident or breakdown?
items.answer: In case of an accident, immediately contact the authorities and our 24/7 customer service. Every rental is covered by insurance. In case of a breakdown, we have a roadside assistance network. All emergency numbers are provided when the keys are handed over.

items.question: How does the deposit system work?
items.answer: A deposit is pre-authorized on your bank card when you pick up the vehicle. The amount varies by vehicle (generally between 100,000 and 500,000 FBU). This deposit is automatically released 7 days after the vehicle is returned, unless there is damage or violations.

items.question: Can I cancel my booking?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel your booking according to the owner's cancellation conditions. Generally: free cancellation up to 24h before the rental starts, 50% refund between 24h and 2h before, no refund less than 2h before.

items.question: How do I list my car for rent?
items.answer: To list your car for rent: create your listing with quality photos, set your prices and availability, and indicate your vehicle handover area. We verify your vehicle and documents. Once approved, your listing is published and you start receiving requests.

items.question: Does CarShare Burundi charge commissions?
items.answer: Yes, we charge a 15% service commission on each rental to cover insurance, customer support, payment processing, and platform maintenance. This commission is transparent and included in the displayed price.

items.question: In which cities is CarShare Burundi available?
items.answer: CarShare Burundi is currently available in Bujumbura, Gitega, Ngozi and Bururi. We plan to expand our services to other cities in the country in 2025. Follow our news to stay informed about new coverage areas.

items.question: How do I contact customer support?
items.answer: Our support team is available Monday to Sunday from 7am to 10pm. You can reach us by phone at +257 XX XX XX XX, by email at support@carshareburundi.com, or via live chat on our website.

items.question: Are the vehicles insured?
items.answer: Yes, all vehicles rented through CarShare Burundi benefit from full insurance coverage including liability, vehicle damage and theft. Coverage details are available in our terms and conditions.
